claims: Documents demonstrating identity are required to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
Documents demonstrating legal presence are required to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
A social security number is required to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
Two proofs of residence are required to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
Residents under 18 years old must complete a driver's education course to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
People over 18 years old without a prior license must pass a theoretical exam to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
People over 18 years old without a prior license must pass a practical exam to obtain a driver's license in Virginia.
The application process for a driver's license in Virginia can be started online through the DMV website.
Certain driver's license procedures in Virginia require an in-person visit.
Driver's licenses in Virginia can be renewed online.
Driver's licenses in Virginia can be renewed by mail.
Driver's license renewal in Virginia must be done in person every two renewal cycles.
Starting May 7, 2025, a REAL ID or another approved federal document such as a passport will be required for domestic flights.
Minors under 18 years old must hold a learner's permit for nine months.
Minors under 18 years old must complete 45 hours of practice driving.
15 of the 45 hours of practice driving for minors under 18 years old must be at night.
A driver's license can be renewed online unless the previous renewal was online or by mail or the license is suspended.
The standard eight-year driver's license renewal costs $32.
If a driver's license was suspended, its status and reinstatement costs can be checked on the DMV license reinstatement site.
The DMV must be notified of any address change within 30 days.
